findings.title: MonthlyLedger.from_dict skips leaf-level numeric validation; a type-confused kwh/sek crashes every cycle forever
findings.claim: A type-confused numeric leaf (e.g. a list or non-numeric string in place of a float) inside a persisted ledger month's 'lines' entry passes MonthlyLedger.from_dict's structural validation, then makes HeatPumpOptimizerCoordinator._build_data_dict() raise an uncaught TypeError/ValueError on every subsequent refresh cycle for the life of the coordinator instance, with no log line and no self-repair.
findings.mechanism: MonthlyLedger.from_dict validates that months[key] is a dict with dict 'lines'/'meta' sub-keys, but copies each lines[*] entry (e.g. {'kwh':..., 'sek':...}) through unparsed; every sibling loader (accuracy.py, price_model.py, wear.py, ...) wraps each numeric leaf's float()/int() coercion in try/except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError), but ledger.py's from_dict never does, so a corrupted leaf only fails downstream, in MonthlyLedger.line()/month_summary()/savings_months(), which _build_data_dict() calls on every cycle with no guard around it.

evidence.machine: shared 4-vCPU cloud container (see BASELINE.md); count/ratio metric, contention-immune
evidence.contention_note: shared box, up to 13 other seats; this is a call-count/exception-count ratio, not timing, so it is final not provisional

perturbation.change: Wrap each lines[*] entry's kwh/sek (and meta[*]'s sum/count) coercion in MonthlyLedger.from_dict inside try/except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError), dropping the enclosing month on failure -- the same leaf guard every sibling loader already has.

findings.metric_definition: escape_rate = (# of 250 seeded ledger mutants where _build_data_dict() raises uncaught after the real loader accepted it) / 250
findings.phenomenon_property: A QuarantiningStore loader's from_dict validates container shape (isinstance dict-of-dict checks) but not every numeric leaf inside a validated container via try/except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError), so a leaf type-confusion mutant is accepted by the loader and only fails on first production read.
findings.seam_rule: grep -n "def from_dict" custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/*.py, then per hit check whether every leaf under a validated container is coerced inside a narrow except; only ledger.py fails this check among the 11 stores checked this round.

null_control.command: same command as above; the harness also runs AccuracyTracker and PriceShapeModel loaders through the identical 250-mutant pool at analogous JSON paths
null_control.note: accuracy_escape_rate=0.0000 and price_model_escape_rate=0.0000 over the same N=250 mutants, ruling out the harness itself as the source of the escapes

reproduction_steps: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1 python3 tools/audit/round8/D1/s2_ledger_fuzz.py
Observe RESULT ledger_escape_rate=0.3240 and RESULT ledger_repeat_rate=1.0000
findings.proposed_fix_scope: custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/ledger.py: MonthlyLedger.from_dict only -- add a leaf-level try/except around each lines[*] entry's kwh/sek coercion, mirroring the pattern already used in accuracy.py/price_model.py/wear.py.

non_findings.claim: The other 10 QuarantiningStore loaders (accuracy, wear/StartCounter, price_model, dhw_draws, defrost, flow_lift, freq_control, snapshots, tariff, comfort_learning, curve_learning, manual_plan, legionella) leaf-guard every numeric coercion they perform.
non_findings.command: grep -n 'def from_dict' custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/*.py, then manual read of each body for a leaf-level try/except around float()/int() coercions
non_findings.value: 10/10 have a leaf-level try/except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError) or an equivalent explicit isinstance guard around every numeric field they parse

non_findings.claim: The null-control stores (accuracy, price_model) show zero escapes over the same 250-mutant pool that finds the ledger gap.

ManualOverride.from_dict's deliberate ManualPlanError raises never escape the coordinator's except (ManualPlanError, AttributeError, TypeError) clause, because parse_channel/_parse_dt re-wrap every ValueError as ManualPlanError before it can propagate.
non_findings.value: no exception type reaches _async_load_manual_plan outside the caught tuple

non_findings.claim: legionella.py's async_load wraps the whole load-and-parse (including _load_switch_record) in one outer try/except Exception, unlike ledger's loader which only wraps the async_load() call itself.
non_findings.value: outer try/except Exception covers all parsing in that loader

non_findings.claim: QuarantiningStore._sanitize (store.py) scrubs non-finite float leaves and non-finite-parseable strings before any loader sees them, so those particular mutants in the pool do not contribute to ledger_loader_raised or the escape count via that path -- the ledger escapes are all leaf TYPE confusion (list/dict/bare string), a distinct gap from the one store.py closes.
